name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
candidate:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intros Hup Hinit
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength Hinit) ?_
    (InitStatesNodup Hinit), ?_⟩
  · exact UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup
  have Hdisj : ks.Disjoint ks' := by
    simp [List.Disjoint]
    intro k hk hk'
    have hd := UpdateStatesDefined Hup k hk
    have hn := InitStatesNotDefined Hinit k hk'
    simp [Option.isSome, hn] at hd
  have Hcomm : updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs =
      updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks vs) ks' vs' := by
    unfold updatedStates
    apply updatedStatesComm
    rw [List.unzip_zip (InitStatesLength Hinit),
      List.unzip_zip (UpdateStatesLength Hup)]
    exact Hdisj.symm
  rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup, ← Hcomm]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength Hup)
    (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))
